title: Analysis tasks
taskHint: Data, evidence and results belong to the current task.
noTaskHint: Create a task, connect Excel or CSV, calculate and save findings.
sourceNotice: Files are registered to this task. Removing a reference keeps the original file and historical evidence.
pending: This connector is planned. Excel / CSV is available now.
previewNotice: Read only, 50 rows per page. Formulas use saved cached values and are not recalculated. Preview is not analysis evidence.
noSourceHint: Add Excel / CSV, then select a worksheet and calculation.
changed: The file has changed. Review the preview, update its version and recalculate. Historical results retain their original fingerprint.
question: Question or task description
questionPlaceholder: For example: check sales by region
calculationNotice: This manual entry uses the selected fields and fixed calculation rules; blank values are not zero. Switch to natural-language analysis to ask a question.
noResultHint: Select the worksheet, columns and calculation. Charts and answers will reference the same result.
draftNotice: Review the evidence before publishing. Publishing checks the file fingerprint and answer version again.
answerLead: The following results use the saved calculation on worksheet “{sheet}” in “{file}”.
scopeHint: Scanned {scanned} rows, matched {matched}; entirely blank rows: {empty}.
timeNotice: This is the execution read time, not the source refresh time.
chartNotice: Chart coordinates are approximate. Evidence retains exact values. Select a value to inspect its source.
countValueHint: For record count, each matching row contributes 1. The cell locates the original record.
emptyEvidence: Run a calculation to see the method, file version and contributing cells.
historical: Saved {time}, using the file version at that time.
historicalChanged: This record uses a different source version from the current task. Recalculate for new findings.
limitations: Current limits: 20 MB per file, 50,000 data rows, 256 columns, 500,000 expanded cells and 100 groups. Exceeding limits stops explicitly.

warnings.CACHED_FORMULAS: Uses cached formula values; no formula recalculation was performed.
warnings.DATE_SYSTEM_1904: Workbook uses the 1904 date system. Date-formatted numbers cannot be used as measures.
warnings.ROUNDING_12_DP: Average display is rounded to 12 decimal places. The exact numerator and denominator are retained.
warnings.TEXT_NUMBERS: Numeric text matching the decimal format was included.

errors.NOT_FOUND: Task, source or calculation not found. Select again.
errors.FILE_UNREADABLE: Cannot read the source file. Check its location and permissions.
errors.FILE_LIMIT: File exceeds the current processing limits. Reduce or split the workbook.
errors.INVALID_WORKBOOK: Cannot parse this file. Check and save it in Excel.
errors.SOURCE_CHANGED: The source version changed. Update the file version and recalculate before publishing.
errors.INVALID_COLUMN: Worksheet or columns do not match. Check the header row and select again.
errors.INVALID_NUMBER: Calculation includes an error, date, boolean or invalid number. Check data and filters.
errors.FORMULA_CACHE_MISSING: A formula has no saved result. Recalculate and save in Excel first.
errors.NO_ROWS: No calculable rows, or a group has no numeric values. Check the selection and filters.
errors.GROUP_LIMIT: More than 100 groups. Results are not truncated. Adjust the grouping or filter.
errors.INVALID_DRAFT: Answer version check failed. Recalculate and review a new answer.
errors.BUSY: This task is still processing. Try again shortly.
errors.STORAGE_ERROR: Operation failed. Retry; if it persists, check application logs.
errors.ANALYSIS_CANCELLED: Analysis stopped. The question is retained; no partial answer was saved.
errors.MODEL_TIMEOUT: Analysis timed out without saving a partial answer. Narrow the question or change the model.
errors.ANALYSIS_CONTEXT_LIMIT: Fields, samples or results exceed the model context budget. Reduce files, split the question or select a larger-context model.
errors.MODEL_NOT_CONFIGURED: Selected model is unavailable. Configure and enable a chat model, then refresh.
errors.INVALID_ANALYSIS_PLAN: The model plan or review failed validation. No formal findings were created. Clarify fields and scope, then retry.
errors.ANALYSIS_UNSUPPORTED: This scope cannot be calculated, for example negative shares, mismatched comparison groups or unsupported operations. Adjust the question or use manual calculation.
errors.MODEL_FAILED: Model request failed. Check the connection, credentials or quota and retry.
errors.REPORT_NOT_PUBLISHED: Publish the answer after reviewing its evidence before creating a report.
errors.REPORT_INVALID_SNAPSHOT: The frozen content or references failed validation. Create a new report.
errors.REPORT_LIMIT: Report content or page count exceeds the current limit. Narrow the question and publish a new answer.
errors.REPORT_LAYOUT: PDF content or layout checks failed. No partial PDF was delivered. Retry frozen content or reduce report scope.
errors.REPORT_RENDER_FAILED: PDF generation did not complete. No partial file was delivered. Retry the frozen content.
errors.REPORT_CANCELLED: Report generation stopped. The answer and frozen evidence are retained.
errors.REPORT_TIMEOUT: Report generation timed out. Retry the frozen content.
errors.REPORT_FILE_CHANGED: A report file or frozen source was modified and cannot be used. Retry generation from the original frozen content.
errors.REPORT_FILE_MISSING: The report or frozen evidence file is missing. Check its location or generate a new report.
errors.REPORT_INTERRUPTED: The previous generation was interrupted by app exit. Retry using the frozen content.
errors.REPORT_SAVE_FAILED: Could not save the file. Use the matching .pdf or .json extension and a writable folder, and close any application locking the file.
errors.METHOD_REQUIREMENTS: Method requirements are unmet. Check fields, object identifiers, rule basis, stage order and window. Missing or duplicate objects cannot be replaced with aggregates.
errors.METHOD_DATA_LIMIT: Method analysis exceeds 2000 filtered records or the 28 MB result limit. Apply explicit filters; no sample has replaced the complete analysis.
errors.CHART_NOT_APPLICABLE: The chart is unsuitable for these fields or results. Check series fields, negative values, zero totals, overlapping labels, stage order and additivity, or select the exact table.
errors.INVALID_ANALYSIS_CONTEXT: The parent version or drill-down scope is invalid. Select the parent and query scope again.
errors.ANALYSIS_DEPTH_LIMIT: This branch reached the 12-level limit. Start a new question.
errors.SQL_READ_ONLY: Use one SELECT / WITH SELECT with supported read-only functions, standard doubled-quote string escaping, no comments, writes, locks or session variables.
errors.SQL_CONNECT_FAILED: Connection failed. Check host, port, TLS and network access.
errors.SQL_AUTH_FAILED: Database authentication failed. Check username and password.
errors.SQL_DATABASE: The database is missing or access is denied.
errors.SQL_QUERY_FAILED: Query failed. Check fields, syntax and unique column aliases.
errors.SQL_LIMIT: The result exceeds row, column or size limits. Narrow the query; no partial snapshot was saved.
errors.SQL_TIMEOUT: Database operation timed out; no query snapshot was saved.
errors.SQL_SECRET_UNAVAILABLE: Encrypted credential storage is unavailable. No plaintext fallback was used.
errors.DATA_SNAPSHOT_IMMUTABLE: A generated snapshot cannot be refreshed from edited bytes. Rerun its query or join.
errors.JOIN_KEY: The join key or source mapping is invalid. Check field types and self-join ambiguity.
errors.JOIN_CARDINALITY: Duplicate keys violate the selected relationship. Resolve duplicates before joining.
errors.JOIN_LIMIT: Join capacity exceeded: 2000 rows per side, 40 output columns, 8 original sources or 12 join steps.
errors.PBI_BRIDGE_UNAVAILABLE: Power BI connector could not start. Rebuild the connector and retry.
errors.PBI_PROTOCOL: Power BI returned an invalid response. Reconnect and retry.
errors.PBI_MODEL_CHANGED: The model changed or reopened. Discover and connect it again.
errors.PBI_NOT_FOUND: The model or workspace was not found. Refresh the selection.
errors.PBI_CONNECT_FAILED: Power BI connection failed. Check the model, endpoint and network.
errors.PBI_DAX_READ_ONLY: Use one read-only EVALUATE query. Commands, comments and multiple statements are not accepted.
errors.PBI_QUERY_FAILED: DAX failed or returned an incomplete result. Check the query and permissions.
errors.PBI_LIMIT: The result exceeds the supported size. Filter the DAX query and retry.
errors.PBI_TIMEOUT: Power BI timed out. Reduce the query and retry.
errors.PBI_CANCELLED: Stopped waiting for the local Power BI operation.
errors.PBI_CLOUD_CANCELLED: Stopped waiting locally. The remote Power BI query may still be running.
errors.PBI_NOT_CONFIGURED: Save your Entra Client ID, Tenant ID and cloud environment first.
errors.PBI_AUTH_REQUIRED: Sign in again to obtain Power BI access.
errors.PBI_AUTH_FAILED: Microsoft sign-in failed. Check the app registration, tenant and consent, then retry.
errors.PBI_ACCOUNT_CHANGED: The account changed. Reload and reconnect the semantic model.
errors.PBI_PERMISSION: Access denied. Check Read/Build permissions, administrator consent and tenant query settings.
errors.PBI_TENANT_DISABLED: The tenant has disabled this Power BI API. Ask its administrator to enable it.
errors.PBI_THROTTLED: Power BI is rate limiting requests. Wait before retrying.
errors.PBI_METADATA_UNAVAILABLE: Model structure is unavailable. Check XMLA capacity and permissions; a known DAX query can still use REST.
errors.PBI_SECRET_UNAVAILABLE: Encrypted sign-in storage is unavailable. Check Windows encryption or sign out locally and reconfigure.
errors.FETCH_TARGET_CHANGED: The connection or data structure changed. Refresh connections and ask again.
errors.FETCH_SCOPE_LOCKED: This follow-up has a fixed data scope. Start a new question to read connected data.
errors.FETCH_QUERY_SCOPE: The generated query is outside the selected schema or cannot be verified as a data read. Clarify tables, fields and business definitions, then retry.
errors.FETCH_PLAN_LIMIT: This request reached its acquisition limit (3 queries and 1 join). Narrow the question and retry.
errors.FETCH_NOT_CONFIGURED: Automatic data acquisition is unavailable. Restart the application.
errors.WORKSPACE_SESSION_MISSING: The linked conversation is unavailable. Check the task and model settings. Evidence and history are preserved.
errors.WORKSPACE_CONFLICT: This conversation already has a task association. Refresh and select it again.
errors.ANALYSIS_TOOL_ARGUMENTS: Analysis tool arguments do not match the contract. Check the fields and data scope.
errors.ANALYSIS_TOOL_REPLAY: The tool arguments or task changed. The original operation cannot be replayed.
errors.ANALYSIS_TOOL_INTERRUPTED: The previous tool operation did not finish. Inspect saved results before repeating an action.
errors.ANALYSIS_REVIEW_REQUIRED: The current conversation and model must read the complete candidate before confirming publication.
errors.ANALYSIS_REFERENCE_STALE: Data or structure changed. Type {'@'} and select the reference again.
errors.ANALYSIS_REFERENCE_UNAVAILABLE: Cannot read this source. Check the connection and retry.
errors.ANALYSIS_CONTEXT_NOT_FOUND: This reference is not available in the current task.
errors.ANALYSIS_QUOTE_INVALID: The passage could not be verified in the saved answer. Select the original text again.

natural.noModel: No enabled chat model is available. Add a provider, configure credentials and enable a model in settings, then refresh.
natural.question: Describe a question or a task
natural.placeholder: For example: sum sales by region, identify the highest region and plot a chart.
natural.followupPlaceholder: Add clarification or ask a follow-up about these files…
natural.modelScope: Calculations run locally. The model receives fields, samples and analysis results, which may include per-object values, for planning and review.
natural.needData: Add Excel/CSV files or choose Read connected data automatically before asking.
natural.emptyTitle: Connect data and ask a question
natural.emptyHint: Ask for aggregates, filters, monthly trends, rankings, shares or period comparisons. Numbers and charts reference executed evidence.
natural.unsupported: This analysis is not supported yet
natural.publishHint: Publishing checks the answer and every referenced source version again.
natural.scopeSentence: Used worksheet “{sheet}” in “{file}” to calculate {operation} of “{measure}”.
natural.rankSummary: Across {count} groups, showing the first {limit} results in {direction} order.
natural.shareSummary: Shares use the sum of groups after filtering as denominator and are calculated locally.
natural.comparisonSummary: Difference and change use current minus baseline. Both periods' filters remain in the evidence.
natural.zeroDenominator: Baseline is zero; percentage change is undefined
natural.derivedInputs: Input calculation results (select to trace further)
natural.precision: Derived ratios display up to 12 decimals. Exact expressions and input references are retained.
natural.versionChanged: A source version changed or was removed. This record retains its historical evidence; recalculate before publishing.
natural.unitNotice: Units follow the original fields. No automatic unit conversion was performed.
natural.allViews: Answer and charts are generated from saved calculation results.
natural.modelFailed: Analysis did not finish. Your question is retained for retry.
natural.dataOnlyChart: These values exceed chart coordinate limits. Exact results remain available in the complete data table.

stages.reviewing: Reviewing the answer against executed results…

reports.title: Reports & outputs
reports.intro: Create a shareable PDF from a published answer, retaining charts, exact values and source evidence.
reports.freezeHint: Uses published content without new model requests or Excel queries. Identical content and options can reuse an existing report.
reports.needPublishedHint: Review the evidence and publish your answer in Analysis before creating a report here.
reports.noReports: No reports for this task yet. Generated reports can be previewed, saved or retried here.
reports.outputHint: Reports and evidence are kept in this app's independent data folder and remain available after restart. Later source changes do not rewrite old reports; regeneration uses the original frozen content.

methods.rowObservation: One observation per row (business grain unverified)
methods.boundaryHint: Ascending, comma separated; blank uses sample quartiles

identities.ratio: Observed metric = first factor / second factor

methods.stageOrder: Stages follow worksheet column order. Use Ctrl for multiple selections. Verify the column order matches the process.
methods.windowComplete: I have verified closed periods / a mature observation window
methods.useRules: Classify by explicit rules (retain overlap and unmatched)
methods.basisHint: State an existing definition or an explicitly chosen standard
methods.requirementHint: Complete required fields before calculating. Negative values, overlap or nonadditive measures can make chart types unsuitable; the engine verifies applicability. Method analysis supports up to 2000 filtered records and 100 categories.
methods.previewOnly: This chart is a viewing variation. Reports retain the chart selected in the published version.

framework.title: Business analysis framework
framework.question: Question
framework.judgmentNotice: Quantities come from local calculations. These judgments are model interpretations and require business verification.
framework.newRoot: New question with no parent branch
framework.searchValue: Search a result by category or value
framework.valueMatches: Showing {shown} of {total} matching results. Search to find other values.
framework.inputRowsNotice: Bound to the selected value's actual input rows. Blank and excluded records are not added. New filters only narrow this scope.
framework.queryScopeNotice: The parent source version, worksheet, header and filters are fixed. New filters only narrow this scope.

data.sqlScope: MySQL supports connection tests, schema, preview and read-only queries. PostgreSQL and legacy DuckDB connections are unavailable.
data.name: Connection name
data.passwordKeep: Leave unchanged to keep the saved password. A new value replaces it.
data.commitInProgress: The result is saving or has completed. Wait for the final result.
data.previewHint: Preview is limited to 50 rows and is not analysis evidence. Run a query to register a result snapshot.
data.queryHint: One SELECT / WITH SELECT with common read-only functions; no comments, writes or multiple statements. Up to 5000 rows, 40 columns, 4 MB and 30 seconds. Excess results fail instead of being truncated.
data.joinHint: Select explicit keys for a left or inner join. The right key must be unique; one-to-one also checks the left key. Text keys keep leading zeros. Up to 2000 rows per side, 40 combined columns and 8 original sources. Repeated joins retain source cells.
data.frozenHint: This source is frozen at the recorded time. Rerun the query or join to create a new version.
data.rowOrdinalHint: The result row number locates a returned record; it is not a business key. FLOAT/DOUBLE retain the database's approximate semantics.

pbi.localHint: Open a PBIX in Power BI Desktop, then discover the running models. Changes in model identity require reconnecting.
pbi.cloudHint: Use your own Microsoft Entra public client application to sign in and select a workspace and semantic model.
pbi.empty: No running model found. Open Power BI Desktop and load a PBIX, then try again.
pbi.manualPort: Connect with a known local port
pbi.applicationHint: Register a public client desktop app in your tenant. Add the mobile/desktop redirect URI http://localhost and delegated Workspace.Read.All / Dataset.Read.All permissions. No client secret is needed. Your administrator may need to grant consent.
pbi.configured: Application settings saved. Sign in to continue.
pbi.signedIn: Signed in. Load workspaces or personal workspace models.
pbi.bound: Model connected. Read its structure or run a DAX query below.
pbi.xmlaHint: Full tables, measures and relationships require an accessible XMLA endpoint and model permissions. If structure is unavailable, use a known DAX query through REST.
pbi.queryHint: One read-only EVALUATE query, up to 5,000 rows and 40 business columns. The complete returned result becomes a new data source for questions, charts and reports.
pbi.resultHint: Row ordinals identify this DAX result. The query may already aggregate data; rows do not necessarily represent underlying transactions.
pbi.precisionHint: Integer and decimal result text is preserved. Floating-point results retain the model’s approximation.
pbi.noSchemaHint: This REST query did not return model structure. Full metadata requires XMLA access.

stages.authenticating: Waiting for Microsoft sign-in in your browser…

pbi.emptySnapshotHint: Connect a Power BI model, run DAX and save its complete result as a snapshot to start analysis.

retrieval.noTarget: This task has no available connections. Use “{connect}” or “{manage}” above to save a MySQL connection or bind a Power BI model.
retrieval.chooseTarget: Select at least one connection to read.
retrieval.allowedConnections: Allowed connections (up to 3 MySQL and 1 Power BI)
retrieval.optionalFiles: Include existing files ({count} selected, up to 6)
retrieval.readHint: The selected model reads connection metadata, generates read-only SQL/DAX, and analyzes a snapshot of the complete returned result. Selected file metadata, samples and query results are sent to that model. Connection passwords and access tokens are never sent.
retrieval.locked: This follow-up inherits a fixed data scope. Start a new question to read connected data.
retrieval.pbiMetadata: Automatic Power BI queries require readable model metadata, usually XMLA access for cloud models. Local models use ADOMD.
retrieval.detached: This snapshot was removed from the task. Frozen evidence in published reports remains available.

workspace.branchNotice: This is an independent branch. Historical evidence uses the snapshot at the branch point.
workspace.branchReconnect: Rebind remote table and measure connections in this branch. Saved data snapshots remain readable.

guide.title: Getting started
guide.intro: Configure a model, create a task and connect data. Check the evidence behind each question, calculation and final answer.
guide.error: Could not load or save guide state. Please retry.
guide.modelBody: Select a configured provider model and set the default. The model interprets questions; analysis tools calculate the numbers.
guide.taskBody: Each task keeps its conversations, data, results and reports. Search, pin or assign a working directory.
guide.dataBody: Connect Excel, CSV, read-only MySQL or Power BI. Type {'@'} to select tables, fields and actual measures in this task. Re-select references after data changes.
guide.fileBody: Inspect worksheets, adjust headers and check previews in Data and files. Attachments and data references stay with the draft.
guide.advancedBody: Select answer text to ask Why, Break it down or Correct the definition. Verify sources, filters and evidence, then confirm and export the final answer.
guide.demoIntro: Built-in example data shows how a report relates to its evidence. No network or model call is needed.
guide.reportBody: The target is 100 and actual is 80: 20 remain and completion is 80%.
guide.sourceBody: Example values: actual 80, target 100. Remaining = 100 − 80 = 20; completion = 80 ÷ 100 = 80%. These values do not come from your task files.
guide.noteBody: Verify facts, calculations and hypotheses separately. Task data, reference versions and final reports retain a traceable analysis record.
guide.connectionIssue: Some sources cannot be read. Check their connections or files, then check again.

references.unavailable: This reference is unavailable. Retry or select it again.
references.retry: Some references did not load. Retry
references.partial: Loaded sources remain available. Retry unavailable connections.
references.more: More results are available. Type a table or field name to narrow the list.
references.empty: No matching tables, fields, measures or files
references.changed: The original answer changed. This reference preserves the selected quotation.
references.missing: The original answer was removed. This reference preserves the selected quotation.
references.quoteNotice: The quotation is follow-up context. Verify numbers using analysis tools and evidence.
references.dataNotice: This reference identifies a source and its structure. No query or calculation has run yet.
references.dataChanged: The data or structure changed. Select the reference again. The original version is preserved.
references.dataMissing: This source was removed from the task. The original reference is preserved.
references.dataUnavailable: This source is temporarily unavailable. Check its connection or file and retry.

followup.label: Follow up on selected text
followup.tooLong: Selection exceeds 2,000 characters. Select a shorter passage.

questions.why: Explain the evidence behind this conclusion. Separate established facts from explanations that need validation.
questions.expand: Break this passage down further and identify dimensions or periods to explore.
questions.correct: I want to change the definition used here. First list the current definition, period and filters.

fileExecution.recordedHint: Recorded program output. Input versions are declared execution provenance; business correctness and a replayable environment are not guaranteed.
